note: Sandusky County OH does not zone its unincorporated land; townships (e.g., Washington, Sandusky Twp) zone via their own resolutions. The largest city, Fremont, publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (2026 zoning map) with no ArcGIS REST or downloadable service found. The Fremont Zoning Explorer is an ArcGIS Experience app with no discoverable service URL. ArcGIS searches for Sandusky County and Fremont zoning returned no zoning district layers. Only third-party copies (zoneomics, Regrid) exist, which are not official.
